decision.explanation: Both answers are explicitly supported by the provided source segments. Document 1 (D1S3, D1S19) states Knut Korsæth received the 'Commander of the Order of St. Olav' from King Olav V. Document 2 (D2S2) states he was bestowed the 'Commander of the Legion of Honour' at the French Embassy. These represent distinct awards from different sources and contexts, satisfying the requirement to preserve multiple legitimate answers for a single referent.
